annotations.title: Bulk list of plans by industry, place and size: address, industry, participants, assets, inception date, recordkeeper

description:
A list of plans for prospecting or research, many per call: plan and sponsor name, mailing address,
EIN and plan number, industry, plan type, effective (inception) date, participants and net assets at the
end of the latest plan year, form type, recordkeeper and primary advisor last seen on Schedule C, and the
filing's ACK ID.

Filter by industry, place (state, city, ZIP), size, plan type, effective date or recordkeeper. Large
(long-form) filers only unless `filer_size` says otherwise. Use `search_plans` instead to find one company's
plan by name, and `get_plan` for everything about one plan. Paging stops at offset 500: narrow the
filters to see more.

Price: $0.25 per call, paid in USDC on Base (mainnet) with x402 (MCP transport), or from card credits (an 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' header). Without payment the tool returns the payment requirements. Errors and empty results aren't charged.

Same data as GET /prospects of the Plan Data API.

city.description: Sponsor's city, as on the filing (case doesn't matter). Best with `state`.
city.title: City

effective_after.description: Only plans whose effective (inception) date is on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).
effective_after.title: Effective After

effective_before.description: Only plans whose effective (inception) date is on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).
effective_before.title: Effective Before

filer_size.description: large (the default) = long-form filers: Form 5500 with Schedule H, generally 100+ participants, with providers on Schedule C. small = 5500-SF or Schedule I. any = both.
filer_size.title: Filer Size

include_ended.description: Include plans that are terminated, merged into another plan, or stopped filing. Off by default.
include_ended.title: Include Ended

industry.description: The sponsor's industry: words ("restaurants", "car dealers", "law firms") or a NAICS business code or its start ("62" = health care, "5411" = legal services). Separate several with commas. `meta.query.industry` lists the codes each one matched.
industry.title: Industry

limit.description: Plans per page (1-100). The price is per call, whatever the limit.
limit.title: Limit

max_assets.description: Maximum end-of-year net assets in dollars.
max_assets.title: Max Assets

min_assets.description: Minimum end-of-year net assets in dollars, in the plan's latest plan year.
min_assets.title: Min Assets

min_participants.description: Minimum end-of-year participants, in the plan's latest plan year.
min_participants.title: Min Participants

plan_type.description: Plan type, as in `search_plans` (e.g. 401k, dc, db).
plan_type.title: Plan Type

recordkeeper.description: Only plans whose latest Schedule C names this recordkeeper (any brand, matched to its family as in `search_plans`).
recordkeeper.title: Recordkeeper

sort.description: assets (largest first, the default), participants (most first), name (A-Z by sponsor) or newest_plan (latest effective date first).
sort.title: Sort

state.description: Two-letter state of the sponsor's address, e.g. OH.
state.title: State

zip.description: Sponsor's ZIP code or its start (3-5 digits), e.g. 432 for the Columbus, OH area.
zip.title: Zip
